title: Service stack (services/<name>.yml)
description: A real Docker Compose file. The x-provision block is a Compose extension field — Compose ignores it, this repo reads it.

port.description: Container port Traefik routes to when a host binds a domain without its own port.

router_service.description: Which compose service Traefik labels attach to. Defaults to the single service, or the one named like the stack.

ingress.description: traefik: labels are generated. host-port: the stack publishes its own ports. none: internal only.

required_env.description: Env vars the stack will not start without. Validation fails if no host supplies them via env/secrets.

optional_env.description: Defaults written into .env when the host does not override them.

data_dirs.description: Directories created (root-owned, 0750) under the stack's volume root before compose up.

singleton.description: Fail validation if more than one host binds this stack.

requires.description: Other stacks that must be bound on the same host (e.g. traefik). Deployed first.

healthcheck_url.description: Fetched from the host after deploy to confirm the rollout. Relative to the container, e.g. http://localhost:3000/healthz.

metrics.description: This stack publishes Prometheus metrics on 127.0.0.1:<port>. vmagent on the same host scrapes it; nothing else can reach it.

job.description: Job label. Defaults to the stack name.

wants_scrape_targets.description: Inject SCRAPE_TARGETS_JSON, the generated list of everything worth scraping on this host. Only vmagent needs it.

backup.description: How this stack's data is captured. A stack with data_dirs must declare this, even if only to say it is not backed up.

reason.description: Required when enabled is false — why this data does not need backing up.

paths.description: Paths under the stack's data root. Defaults to data_dirs.

pre.description: Shell commands run before the snapshot, with STACK, DATA_ROOT and STAGING exported. Where a database makes itself consistent.

post.description: Cleanup, run whether or not the backup succeeded.

stop.description: Stop the stack for the duration. Correct but an outage; prefer a pre hook.
